author: Contributor 173
about: Tide Labs, a two-person studio, runs its Volter Harness agent on Telegram (a bot polling for updates, answering in private and in the team group, where privacy mode keeps a plain member from hearing the team until it is made an administrator, posting a scheduled digest, and sending a finished card's release notes as a document) and publishes its news to a Telegram channel through Scheduler (connected by a /connect post, then text, an album, a reply, a photo, a video and a PDF), from January to the agent's retirement at the end of February.

steps.name: Monday 5 January, 10:00 in Lisbon
Ana signs up for Telegram in the app
Bruno signs up for Telegram in the app
Ana makes the studio's agent bot with BotFather (/newbot) and is given its token
Ana opens the agent bot in Telegram and presses Start
...and writes to it

body.text: Hi! I'm Ana from Tide Labs. Can you keep notes of our standups?

steps.name: 10:05: Ana starts Volter Harness with the token in her profile
Harness's Telegram adapter reads its bot
...removes any webhook before it polls, keeping what is pending
...and polls: Ana's Start and her message are waiting

expect.equals: Hi! I'm Ana from Tide Labs. Can you keep notes of our standups?

steps.name: It shows the bot typing in her private chat while the agent works
...and posts the agent's answer there

body.text: Hi Ana! I'll keep notes of each standup and post a digest of it. Add me to your team chat and mention me there.

steps.name: 11:00: the team chat
Ana makes the group "Tide Labs team" with Bruno and the agent bot, which the app adds as a plain member
Harness's poll, from the update after the last it read, receives its own membership and the group's creation (a service message, which privacy mode lets through)
Bruno tells the team when the standup is

body.text: Morning all! Standups are at 9:00 on Tuesdays, starting tomorrow. Post your items here.

steps.name: Bruno asks the agent in the group

body.text: @tidelabs_agent_bot what did Ana ask you to track?

steps.name: 11:25: no answer comes; Ana reads that a bot in privacy mode is not sent a plain mention, and an administrator bot is sent every message
Ana makes the agent bot an administrator of the group
Bruno asks again, with the standup time

body.text: @tidelabs_agent_bot standups are at 9:00 on Tuesdays from tomorrow, items posted here. What did Ana ask you to track?

steps.name: Harness's next poll receives its promotion and Bruno's second question; his two earlier messages were never sent to it

expect.equals: @tidelabs_agent_bot standups are at 9:00 on Tuesdays from tomorrow, items posted here. What did Ana ask you to track?

steps.name: The agent answers Bruno in the group

body.text: Ana asked me to keep notes of your standups: post your items here at 9:00 on Tuesdays and I will post the digest at 9:15.

steps.name: Tuesday 6 January, 09:00: the standup
Ana posts her standup items in the group

body.text: Today: release notes for 0.9. Yesterday: CI cache fixed.

steps.name: Harness's poll, held open, returns with her item as she posts it

expect.equals: Today: release notes for 0.9. Yesterday: CI cache fixed.

steps.name: Bruno posts his

body.text: Today: the login redirect bug. Blocked on: staging credentials.

steps.name: Harness's next poll, from the update after hers, returns with Bruno's item as he posts it

expect.equals: Today: the login redirect bug. Blocked on: staging credentials.

steps.name: 09:15: the digest
Harness's scheduled job posts the standup digest to the home chat

body.text:
Standup digest, Tuesday 6 January

Ana: release notes for 0.9 today; CI cache fixed yesterday.
Bruno: the login redirect bug today; blocked on staging credentials.

steps.name: Wednesday 7 January, 14:00
Ana makes the public channel "Tide Labs News" (@tidelabs_news) with the studio logo as its photo

body.creator: {ana}
body.title: Tide Labs News
body.description: Releases and notes from Tide Labs.

steps.name: Ana makes the news bot with BotFather for Scheduler, which she runs herself (docker compose, local storage)
...and adds it to the channel as an administrator that may post and delete messages
14:06: Ana sets her Scheduler's TELEGRAM_TOKEN to the news bot's token and, in Scheduler, chooses to add Telegram
Scheduler's connect screen polls the news bot: only the bot's own promotion is waiting, and it holds no /connect
Ana posts the command Scheduler shows her in the channel
Scheduler polls again from the next update (the last update_id it saw plus one) and finds the /connect post
Scheduler reads its bot
...checks the bot may delete messages in the channel
...deletes the /connect post
...and posts its notice
ten seconds later
Scheduler deletes its notice
Scheduler reads the channel it is connecting
...the photo's file, to make its link
...and copies the picture into its storage from the link
Thursday 8 January, 10:00
Scheduler publishes the launch post (Scheduler's HTML: a bold title, two paragraphs)

expect.equals:
Tide is live
Tide plans and ships weekly releases for small teams.
Try it free at https://tide.example and tell us what you think.

steps.name: 11:00: Ana asks the agent for the release notes
Ana asks the agent in her private chat for the 0.9 release notes

body.text: Can you draft the release notes for 0.9 from this week's merged work? I need them by Friday.

steps.name: Harness's poll receives her request

expect.equals: Can you draft the release notes for 0.9 from this week's merged work? I need them by Friday.

steps.name: It shows the bot typing while the agent files the card
The agent answers that the card is on the board and this chat will hear when it is done

body.text: On it: "Draft the 0.9 release notes" is card release-notes on the board, and this chat will get the notes when it is done.

steps.name: Friday 9 January, 15:00: the card is done
Harness's board tells the subscribed chat the card is done, its notes attached (the Chat SDK sends a message with files as MarkdownV2)

parts.name: caption
parts.value:
✔ card release\-notes done — Draft the 0\.9 release notes
Notes for Tide 0\.9: drag to reschedule a release, a faster dashboard and the login redirect fix\.

expect.equals:
✔ card release-notes done — Draft the 0.9 release notes
Notes for Tide 0.9: drag to reschedule a release, a faster dashboard and the login redirect fix.

steps.name: Monday 12 January, 10:00
Scheduler publishes the 0.9 release with three screenshots as one album, the text on the first

expect.equals:
Tide 0.9
A dashboard for every release, a timeline you can drag, and settings in one place.

steps.name: Scheduler publishes the post's comment, the changelog, as a reply to the album
18:00: the standups move to a video call
Ana removes the agent bot from "Tide Labs team"
Tuesday 13 January, 09:15
The digest job, still on, posts to the home chat and is refused

body.text:
Standup digest, Tuesday 13 January

No standup items were posted this week.

expect.equals: Forbidden: bot was kicked from the group chat

steps.name: Wednesday 14 January, 16:00
Scheduler sends Ana's product photo with its 1,091-character story, and Telegram refuses the caption

expect.equals: Bad Request: message caption is too long

steps.name: 16:20: Ana cuts the story to a paragraph
Scheduler sends the photo again with the short caption
Monday 19 January, 11:00
Scheduler publishes the product demo video
Scheduler publishes the white paper as a PDF
Friday 27 February, 17:00
Ana retires the agent: in BotFather she makes a new token (/token), which revokes the one Harness holds
Harness, still running on her laptop, polls with the old token and is refused
